reason: Confirmed: `elementContentByID` (internal/amazon/collector.go:497-511) stops at the first ``, so on the real `#acrPopover` markup (internal/amazon/testdata/rating-fr.html:14-17) the fallback text is only `4,5`, `starsPattern` does not match and the rating is recorded as absent. That breaks the TS-AMZ-ITEM-AIR-001 contract ('else its text content'). The 'rating in the text only' case (customer_rating_test.go:91) passes only because `a-icon-alt` is the first child, so the test does not prove the case.

Accurate but documentation-only: doc/FUNCTIONAL_SPECIFICATIONS.md:176 and :272 (and the 'specified' status of 5.6a, FR-43 and the specification index) still describe issue #305 as future work. This has no effect on behaviour or contracts and can be fixed when the status is updated to implemented.
